# Eight System One — 5-Slide Outline

## Slide 1: Title & Vision
- Title: "Eight System One: A Local Decision Engine for 8gent"
- Subtitle: Calibrated probabilities, code-owned thresholds, local models
- Hook: One question — "Would running this shell command delete, overwrite, or exfiltrate data?" — answered by a small local model in milliseconds.

## Slide 2: The Contract
- Three question kinds: `noul` (yes/no), `choice` (pick from 2–255 options), `score` (rate on 2–10 levels)
- Request: `{ state, questions[] }` → Response: `{ answers[], backend, model, latencyMs }`
- Key principle: backends report probability mass only; **code owns thresholds**
- Memoised (up to 256 requests) for deterministic same-input → same-output

## Slide 3: Backends & Probe
- **llamacpp** — in-process via `node-llama-cpp`, no server, loads GGUF from Ollama blob store
- **laya** — local `laya-serve` over HTTP, probabilities renormalised client-side
- **ollama** — `/api/generate` with `raw: true`, `temperature 0`, logprobs, answer-token mapping
- **mock** — deterministic heuristic for tests
- `detectBackend()` auto-probes in order: llamacpp → laya → Ollama; picks smallest non-embedding model

## Slide 4: Bash Guard & Rule Pre-Filter
- `bashGuard` asks a yes/no question about a shell command; verdicts: `allow` / `escalate` / `block`
- Three prompt-injection defences: prompt-control rule, fenced JSON-encoded state, comment-stripping
- `rules.ts` (deterministic pre-filter): parses commands as text, fires on `rm -rf /`, disk wipe, secret-to-network, remote-code-to-shell, etc.
- Invariant: rules only make verdicts **stricter**; no allow path in rules
- Measured: 100% destructive recall, 0% safe false-block on 40 commands with Selene

## Slide 5: Harness Integration & Results
- `EIGHT_SYSTEM_ONE=1` gates the bash guard onto every agent shell path (`run_command`, `background_start`, `spawn_agent`)
- Off by default; warm-up at TUI startup; fail-closed on any error or timeout
- Selene-1 (8B, Q4_K_M): 95% accuracy, 100% destructive recall, 0% false-block, AUC 1.000, p50 610 ms
- Locate mode routing (M2) and semantic mode (M3) extend the engine to code navigation
- Next: pass the eval gate with a calibrated model; ship the deterministic logit scorer interface
